status: design frozen before main campaign; preflight excluded
scope: Own method only. Parameter sensitivity and static planner-query study, not external comparison or physical closed-loop qualification.

references.paper: Real-time Spatial-temporal Traversability Assessment via Feature-based Sparse Gaussian Process
references.adopted: five terrain categories; inducing-budget accuracy/runtime sensitivity; separate dimensionless risk error from height error
references.not_reproduced: original traversability ground-truth formula, temporal posterior fusion, original datasets and external baselines

references.adopted: random start-goal queries, planning time and path length; retain rejection and failures
references.not_reproduced: full mapping-kernel timing, vehicle dynamics or original environment set

references.paper: An Efficient Trajectory Planner for Car-Like Robots on Uneven Terrain
references.adopted: repeated random queries; planning time and curvature alongside feasibility
references.not_reproduced: polynomial trajectory curvature, physical tracking or original terrain scenes

terrain.controlled: same masked input and noise paired across M; max_train_points=512 fixed, local conditioning on; no unknown completion; random budget order; ground labels supplied
terrain.statistics: source-group equal-weight summaries, paired differences and source bootstrap 95% intervals; disclose empty denominators and supported-reference counts

planning.timing_boundary: executePlannerJob synchronous whole call; excludes CDR loading, map update and independent validation; fresh node per repetition but not machine cold start
planning.reference: independent dense 13x11 footprint and rectangle SAT along 0.05m path samples; geometric proxy only
planning.exclusions: invalid initial states reported not silently removed; local safe partial paths separate from complete goal connections; reject-target queries separate from reachable queries
